title: AIDISA: AI-Driven Intelligent Situation Awareness System
subtitle: Full-stack operational analytics platform for SMRT, combining backend APIs, NLP workflows, GPT-assisted triage, and production delivery across Azure environments.

overview.title: Overview
overview.summary: AiDiSA was built to replace manual commuter-feedback handling with an end-to-end analytics workflow that could classify, assign, and escalate issues in near real time for transport operations teams.
overview.problem: SMRT teams were handling commuter feedback across email, webforms, and internal systems using labour-intensive triage and manual assignment. The process slowed incident response, increased inconsistency, and made it harder to identify critical issues early.
overview.solution: I designed and delivered a modular full-stack platform with Django REST Framework, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MS SQL, Next.js, Power BI, and NLP services. The system automated triage, improved routing, surfaced urgent incidents faster, and gave operational teams a clearer live view of incoming issues.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.intro: The platform separated ingestion, triage, classification, assignment, and alerting into clear services so operational logic could evolve without destabilising the whole system. FastAPI and Django handled API and business workflows, while transformer and GPT-assisted pipelines were kept modular for safer iteration.
architecture.code:
router.post("/triage")
async def triage_feedback(payload: FeedbackPayload):
    sentiment = sentiment_service.score(payload.message)
    severity = llm_classifier.classify(payload.message)
    keywords = keyword_service.extract(payload.message)
    queue_item = assignment_engine.route(
        channel=payload.channel,
        severity=severity,
        sentiment=sentiment,
        keywords=keywords,
    )
    await case_repo.save(queue_item)
    return {"status": "queued", "severity": severity}
architecture.outro: This kept the system practical for operators: APIs stayed clean, services remained replaceable, and deployment across staging and production environments stayed manageable through Docker and CI/CD.

stacks.title: Tech Stacks
stacks.summary: The implementation leaned on a compact mix of backend, frontend, data, and NLP tooling that could be deployed reliably and maintained by a small engineering team.

impact.title: Impact And Results
impact.summary: The value of the project was measured in reduced manual effort, faster response to urgent cases, and better operational visibility across transport teams.

items.title: Automated Feedback Routing
items.text: Reduced the daily burden on operations staff by automatically assigning cases using a workload-aware routing approach.

items.title: Real-Time Incident Visibility
items.text: Enabled near real-time flagging of high-priority incidents so urgent commuter issues could be surfaced earlier.

items.title: Operational Dashboarding
items.text: Improved visibility across multiple divisions through a unified portal and reporting layer for active case monitoring.

items.title: Production Delivery
items.text: Shortened deployment cycles from days to hours by containerising services and setting up repeatable CI/CD pipelines.
